description:
China has built an arsenal of “carrier killer” missiles designed to threaten US aircraft carriers—but what happens if the US and its allies flip the script?

A new CSIS report lays out five ways the US and its allies could put China’s growing aircraft carrier fleet at risk, from submarines and chokepoints to drones, cyber warfare, and long-range strikes.

China may be building more carriers, but getting them safely out of its own backyard could be a much bigger problem.
